sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellants submitted that, there are general and omnibus allegation against the present appellant.
DNA Report is positive qua the co-accused Vijay Ahirwar.
There are good chances of success in appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend the execution of remain part of the jail sentence of the appellant Deepak Agirwar and to release him on bail.
Shri S.K. Shrivastava, learned Government Advocate supports the impugned judgment and opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record so also looking to the fact that the appeal is going to take time for its disposal and there are good chances of success in appeal,
without commenting on the merits of the case, this court is of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of appellant Deepak Ahirwar and to release him on bail.
Accordingly, I.A. No.25578 of 2025 is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court 13.02.2026 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the concerned Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of appellant 3 CRA-10441-2025 Deepak Ahirwar shall remain suspended and he be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
C.C. as per rules.
List this case alongwith CRA No. 10659 of 2025 filed on behalf of the co-accused Vijay Ahirwar.
